disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 全量核查硬编码密钥与凭据模式，未发现 API 密钥、云凭据、SSH 私钥、钱包助记词等硬编码值。
checked_items.en: Full audit of hardcoded credential patterns: no API keys, cloud credentials, SSH private keys, wallet mnemonics, or other hardcoded values detected.

checked_items.zh: 核查敏感路径读取面：插件只读写自己生成的 8 位访问密码文件（token/token-lan，存放于 $DSH_HOME/dsh-pocket/ 子目录，权限 600）与设置文件（settings.json，权限 600），未读取宿主凭据文件、SSH 私钥或云凭据。Cloudflare Tunnel Token 同样以 0o600 存于设置文件，RPC 只写不读。
checked_items.en: Audit of sensitive path read surface: the plugin only reads and writes its own generated 8-digit access password file (token/token-lan, stored in $DSH_HOME/dsh-pocket/ subdirectory, permission 600) and settings file (settings.json, permission 600). It does not read host credential files, SSH private keys, or cloud credentials. The Cloudflare Tunnel Token is also stored in the settings file with 0o600 permission; RPC only writes it and does not read it.

checked_items.zh: 核查凭据批量搜集语义（全盘搜索密钥、云账号枚举、钱包资产发现），命中 0。
checked_items.en: Audit of credential bulk collection semantics (disk-wide key search, cloud account enumeration, wallet asset discovery): 0 hits.

evidence.zh: 插件读取的敏感数据仅限自己生成的 8 位访问密码文件（token/token-lan）与 Cloudflare Tunnel Token（存于 settings.json 且 RPC 回显仅 tokenSet 布尔值），未读取宿主凭据文件、SSH 私钥或云凭据；密码文件以 600 权限写入，仅在登录验证时比对，不随网络流量外发。
evidence.en: The sensitive data read by the plugin is limited to its own generated 8-digit access password file (token/token-lan) and the Cloudflare Tunnel Token (stored in settings.json, and the RPC response only returns the tokenSet boolean). It does not read host credential files, SSH private keys, or cloud credentials. The password file is written with permission 600 and is only compared during login verification; it is not sent outbound with network traffic.

checked_items.zh: 核查插件注册的全部对外文本面：本插件不注册任何供模型调用的工具，只注册设置页签与移动端界面组件，无工具描述文本可投毒。
checked_items.en: Audit of all external text surfaces registered by the plugin: this plugin does not register any tools for model invocation; it only registers a settings tab and mobile UI components. There is no tool description text that can be poisoned.

checked_items.zh: 核查 README、LOCAL-DEV.md、源码注释、界面文案（含中英文词典）中是否有指令覆写、伪造系统消息、要求读取凭据等注入措辞，命中 0。
checked_items.en: Audit of README, LOCAL-DEV.md, source code comments, and UI copy (including Chinese-English dictionary) for injection wording such as instruction override, fake system message, or request to read credentials: 0 hits.

checked_items.zh: 全树扫描未发现 AGENTS.md、SKILL.md、Claude/Cursor 指令文件、MCP 配置等模型面指令文件。
checked_items.en: Full tree scan did not find model-facing instruction files such as AGENTS.md, SKILL.md, Claude/Cursor instruction files, or MCP configuration.

checked_items.zh: 核查客户端注入网页的脚本（randomUUID polyfill、AbortSignal.any polyfill、桌面端 advanced 模式提示覆盖层）与 CompactionEngine 子类实现：注入脚本均为静态固定内容，无远程动态或指令性文本；未检出压缩引擎子类，不存在历史压缩篡改路径。
checked_items.en: Audit of scripts injected into the client web page (randomUUID polyfill, AbortSignal.any polyfill, desktop advanced mode hint overlay) and CompactionEngine subclass implementations: the injected scripts are all static fixed content, with no remote dynamic or instructional text; no compression engine subclass detected, no historical compression tampering path exists.

evidence.zh: 本插件不注册任何模型可调用的工具，无工具描述文本可投毒；设置页与移动端界面文案经语义审查无注入措辞。
evidence.en: This plugin does not register any tools callable by the model; there is no tool description text that can be poisoned. The settings page and mobile UI copy have been semantically reviewed and contain no injection wording.

evidence.zh: 插件没有任何面向模型的工具描述，不存在诱导模型执行安装、改写配置的文本载体。
evidence.en: The plugin has no model-facing tool descriptions; there is no text carrier that could induce the model to execute installations or modify configurations.

evidence.zh: 未检出对模型输入守门事件（agent/pre-step）的监听，插件不改写或注入模型看到的用户消息。
evidence.en: No listener detected for model input guard events (agent/pre-step); the plugin does not rewrite or inject user messages seen by the model.

checked_items.zh: 核查全部源码中的进程调用共 6 处：插件自更新（调用 dsh 命令拉取新版）、自重启（拉起辅助进程重建宿主）、WSL 局域网 IP 探测（ipconfig）、cloudflared 下载解压与隧道进程、cloudflared 路径探测（command -v/where）。逐处确认参数固定或来自宿主自身启动参数，无外部输入拼入命令，用途与声明功能一致，判定为良性。
checked_items.en: Audit of all process invocations in the source code: 6 total. Plugin self-update (calls dsh command to pull new version), self-restart (spawns helper process to rebuild host), WSL LAN IP detection (ipconfig), cloudflared download and extraction and tunnel process, cloudflared path detection (command -v/where). Each instance confirms that parameters are fixed or come from the host's own startup parameters; no external input is spliced into the command. The purpose aligns with the declared functionality, judged as benign.

checked_items.zh: 核查客户端打包产物中的键盘监听（两处）：都是移动端抽屉按 Escape 键关闭的 UI 逻辑，仅比对按键名，无键盘记录、无剪贴板读取、无凭据接口调用，判定为良性。
checked_items.en: Audit of keyboard listeners in the client build artifacts (two instances): both are UI logic for closing the mobile drawer by pressing the Escape key. They only compare key names; no keylogging, no clipboard reading, no credential interface calls. Judged as benign.

checked_items.zh: 核查打包产物与测试文件中的高密度转义文本（两处）：都是中文注释与测试数据被构建工具转成 Unicode 转义或在测试中保留中文 Unicode 原文，非刻意混淆，判定为良性。
checked_items.en: Audit of high-density escaped text in build artifacts and test files (two instances): both are Chinese comments and test data that were converted to Unicode escapes by the build tool or retain Chinese Unicode original text in tests. Not deliberate obfuscation, judged as benign.

checked_items.zh: 核查仓库自带的 GitHub Actions 工作流（release.yml 和 test.yml）：仅触发 npm 测试与发布，无外联脚本、无凭据读取、无隐蔽下载执行，属常规工程流程，判定为良性。
checked_items.en: Audit of the repository's built-in GitHub Actions workflows (release.yml and test.yml): they only trigger npm tests and publishing. No outbound scripts, no credential reading, no covert download and execution. Normal engineering workflow, judged as benign.

checked_items.zh: 未检出 eval、动态函数构造、Base64 解码即执行等动态执行模式；未检出 cordis 动态包工具调用。
checked_items.en: No eval, dynamic function construction, Base64 decode and execute, or other dynamic execution patterns detected; no cordis dynamic package tool calls detected.

checked_items.zh: 未检出安装钩子（preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare），依赖均锁定 npm 官方源，无浮动的 git 依赖。
checked_items.en: No install hooks detected (preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare). Dependencies are all locked to the npm official registry; no floating git dependencies.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置 cordis.patch.yml 仅含一条插件插入声明，全文无任何 JS 执行标量（!!js），loader 不会在宿主进程求值任意代码。
evidence.en: The patch configuration cordis.patch.yml contains only a single plugin insertion declaration. The entire file has no JS execution scalar (!!js); the loader will not evaluate arbitrary code in the host process.

evidence.zh: 未检出对动态包工具（cordis_define/cordis_run 类）的调用，插件没有让模型在宿主 vm 里跑代码的接口。
evidence.en: No calls to dynamic package tools (cordis_define/cordis_run type) detected; the plugin has no interface that allows the model to run code in the host VM.

evidence.zh: package.json 无任何安装钩子脚本；依赖均来自 npm 官方源并锁定版本范围，无 git 浮动引用；仓库内 CI 工作流仅做测试与发布，无外联下载执行。
evidence.en: package.json has no install hook scripts; dependencies are all from the npm official registry with version ranges locked, no floating git references; the CI workflows in the repository only do testing and publishing, no outbound download and execution.

evidence.zh: 插件声明了 dsh.client 客户端模块并对打包产物做了专项核查：键盘监听仅用于 Escape 关闭抽屉，无剪贴板访问、无凭据 RPC 调用、无可疑外联，属良性 UI 行为。
evidence.en: The plugin declares a dsh.client client module and a dedicated audit of the build artifacts was performed: keyboard listeners are only used for Escape to close the drawer; no clipboard access, no credential RPC calls, no suspicious outbound connections. This is benign UI behavior.

evidence.zh: 未检出子代理提供方注册（registerProvider 类），插件不会把轮次委派给进程外 agent 产品。
evidence.en: No sub-agent provider registration (registerProvider class) detected; the plugin does not delegate rounds to out-of-process agent products.

evidence.zh: 未检出 dsh 原生持驻注册（后台任务、定时提醒、持久目标、轮次续命监听），插件没有安装后持续存活或周期触发的宿主级任务；公网隧道自动恢复属用户主动开启功能的延续，与声明一致。
evidence.en: No dsh native persistent registration detected (background tasks, scheduled reminders, persistent goals, round keep-alive listeners). The plugin has no host-level tasks that persist after installation or trigger periodically. The automatic restoration of the public tunnel is a continuation of the user's active enabling of the feature, consistent with the declaration.

checked_items.zh: 枚举了全部网络外联点：npm registry 版本检查（registry.npmjs.org）、cloudflared 二进制下载（官方 GitHub + 清华镜像 + 国内加速源）、公网隧道到 Cloudflare 边缘（trycloudflare.com 或用户自建命名隧道）——均为插件声明功能所需，无未声明端点。
checked_items.en: Enumerated all network outbound points: npm registry version check (registry.npmjs.org), cloudflared binary download (official GitHub + Tsinghua mirror + domestic acceleration source), public tunnel to Cloudflare edge (trycloudflare.com or user-defined named tunnel) — all are required by the plugin's declared functionality; no undeclared endpoints.

checked_items.zh: 核查了敏感文件读取后编码外发的组合链（读取 → 编码/压缩 → 网络发送），命中 0；插件只处理自己的密码文件，无凭据外发通道。
checked_items.en: Audited the combination chain of reading sensitive files and then encoding/sending them outbound (read → encode/compress → network send): 0 hits. The plugin only handles its own password file; there is no credential exfiltration channel.

checked_items.zh: 核查了 DNS 隧道、Webhook 回调、AI 端点劫持、代理环境变量劫持等带外通道模式，命中 0。
checked_items.en: Audited out-of-band channel patterns such as DNS tunneling, Webhook callbacks, AI endpoint hijacking, and proxy environment variable hijacking: 0 hits.

evidence.zh: 插件读取的敏感数据仅限自己生成的 8 位访问密码文件；公网隧道暴露的是用户主动开启的访问入口，密码不随隧道流量外发，未发现凭据外泄通道。
evidence.en: The sensitive data read by the plugin is limited to its own generated 8-digit access password file. The public tunnel exposes an access entry that the user actively enables; the password is not sent outbound with tunnel traffic. No credential exfiltration channel was found.

evidence.zh: 未检出对模型请求路由事件（agent/request、agent/request-error）的监听，也未注册自定义模型适配器，不存在运行时把对话重路由到未声明端点的路径。
evidence.en: No listener detected for model request routing events (agent/request, agent/request-error), and no custom model adapter registered. There is no path for runtime rerouting of conversations to undeclared endpoints.

checked_items.zh: 核对依赖清单：运行时依赖仅 qrcode 与 qrcode-terminal（知名稳定库），宿主 SDK 为官方 @deepseek-ai/cordis，无 typosquatting、无与 dsh 生态命名撞车的可疑包。
checked_items.en: Verified dependency list: runtime dependencies are only qrcode and qrcode-terminal (well-known stable libraries), the host SDK is the official @deepseek-ai/cordis. No typosquatting, no suspicious packages that conflict with dsh ecosystem naming.

checked_items.zh: 核查挂载配置 cordis.patch.yml：只做插件插入（insert），未触碰沙箱/审批/权限等安全配置行，无 disabled 降权、无环境变量降权写法。
checked_items.en: Audited patch configuration cordis.patch.yml: only plugin insertion (insert); does not touch security configuration lines like sandbox/approval/permissions. No disabled privilege reduction, no environment variable privilege reduction patterns.

checked_items.zh: 未检出对安全事件的抢先监听，未检出拦截/注入配置改写。
checked_items.en: No preemptive listener for security events detected; no interception or injection of configuration modifications detected.

checked_items.zh: 发布流程为常规 npm publish（GitHub Actions 触发手动 workflow_dispatch），无安装期远程脚本执行。
checked_items.en: The release process is a standard npm publish (triggered by manual workflow_dispatch in GitHub Actions); no remote script execution during installation.

checked_items.zh: 版本对比：与上版 1.14.5 相比，manifest 能力声明未见突变（仍为 bundle patch + client），无升级自动激活新增面。
checked_items.en: Version comparison: compared to the previous version 1.14.5, the manifest capability declaration shows no sudden change (still bundle patch + client); no new surfaces are automatically activated on upgrade.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置仅含一条 insert 声明，未触碰沙箱、审批、权限等安全配置行，无 disabled 降权、无环境变量降权写法。
evidence.en: The patch configuration only contains one insert declaration; it does not touch security configuration lines such as sandbox, approval, or permissions. No disabled privilege reduction, no environment variable privilege reduction patterns.

evidence.zh: 未检出对工具预执行或审批请求等安全事件的优先监听，插件不介入审批链，不存在截断可能。
evidence.en: No priority listener detected for tool pre-execution or approval request security events; the plugin does not intervene in the approval chain; there is no possibility of truncation.

evidence.zh: 与上版 1.14.5 对比，manifest 能力声明（bundle patch + client）无突变，未出现升级自动激活新增面。
evidence.en: Compared to the previous version 1.14.5, the manifest capability declaration (bundle patch + client) shows no sudden change; no new surfaces are automatically activated on upgrade.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置未改写注入或拦截配置，不存在给安全插件追加必需服务致其永久挂起的路径。
evidence.en: The patch configuration does not modify injection or interception configurations; there is no path that would add required services to security plugins causing them to hang indefinitely.

checked_items.zh: 核查插件是否启动网络服务：插件会启动一个反向代理（默认监听 0.0.0.0:3081）把手机流量转发到本机 dsh web——这是插件核心功能（手机访问），已在能力声明与文档中明示。
checked_items.en: Audit whether the plugin starts a network service: the plugin starts a reverse proxy (default listen on 0.0.0.0:3081) to forward mobile traffic to the local dsh web — this is the plugin's core functionality (mobile access), which has been clearly stated in the capability declaration and documentation.

checked_items.zh: 核查该服务的安全设计：公网入口强制 8 位密码并每次开启自动轮换、登录失败有速率限制（单 IP 5 次/分钟触发锁 60 秒、全局 50 次/分钟锁 30 秒）、开启公网前强制阅读免责声明（服务端校验不可绕过）、WebSocket 同样校验、会话 cookie 绑定进程级随机密钥——防护措施与暴露面匹配。
checked_items.en: Audit of the service's security design: the public entry requires an 8-digit password that is automatically rotated each time it is enabled; login failure has rate limiting (single IP 5 times/minute triggers a 60-second lock, global 50 times/minute triggers a 30-second lock); forced reading of a disclaimer before enabling public access (server-side validation cannot be bypassed); WebSocket is also validated; session cookie is bound to a process-level random key — the protection measures match the exposure surface.

checked_items.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证（本环境无动态沙箱产物），运行时行为基于静态分析结论。
checked_items.en: Dynamic sandbox verification was not performed (no dynamic sandbox artifact in this environment); runtime behavior is based on static analysis conclusions.

evidence.zh: 插件启动的反向代理属声明功能。相对宿主原生 web 服务，该代理为公网/局域网访问额外加了密码认证、速率限制与免责声明确认，未发现超越声明的无认证暴露面。
evidence.en: The reverse proxy started by the plugin is a declared functionality. Compared to the host's native web service, this proxy adds password authentication, rate limiting, and disclaimer confirmation for public/LAN access. No unauthorized exposure surface beyond the declaration was found.

summary.zh: 元数据与身份核对通过：包名、版本、仓库地址与任务卡一致；dsh 字段声明确认（bundle patch + client）。
summary.en: Metadata and identity verification passed: package name, version, repository address match the task card; dsh field declaration confirmed (bundle patch + client).

summary.zh: 静态扫描完成：预扫 16 条机械命中全部逐条核查并判定为良性功能用法，未检出动态执行、凭据窃取、外联等危险模式。
summary.en: Static scan complete: all 16 mechanical hits from the pre-scan were individually reviewed and judged as benign functional usage; no dangerous patterns such as dynamic execution, credential theft, or outbound connections detected.

summary.en: Behavior analysis complete: child process invocation, network outbound connections, and file writes all correspond to declared functionality; no install hooks, no obfuscated payloads, no sensitive path reading.

summary.zh: AI 元数据审查完成：插件无模型工具描述；客户端注入文本与界面文案经语义审查无注入措辞。
summary.en: AI metadata review complete: the plugin has no model tool descriptions; client-injected text and UI copy have been semantically reviewed and contain no injection wording.

summary.zh: 本环境未提供动态沙箱产物（l4-sandbox.json 不存在），未做动态验证。
summary.en: This environment did not provide a dynamic sandbox artifact (l4-sandbox.json does not exist); dynamic verification was not performed.

target.zh: dsh-pocket@2.1.4#663276bcf8fed483d7fbe6c4119bf2ed1e19e590（仓库根，完整审计）；上版 1.14.5@13e52db3 基线用于版本对比
target.en: dsh-pocket@2.1.4#663276bcf8fed483d7fbe6c4119bf2ed1e19e590 (repository root, full audit); previous version 1.14.5@13e52db3 baseline used for version comparison

limits.zh:
1) 本环境未提供动态沙箱产物（l4-sandbox.json 不存在），DG-L4 动态验证未执行，运行时行为基于静态分析结论。
2) package.json 的 dsh 声明不含显式能力清单字段，插件能力（网络、进程调用、文件写入）由代码实测推断，已在 capability_diff 对账。
3) context/manifest.json 所列文件全部在源码树中可定位，已核查其中全部代码与配置类文件；docs 下的图片资源未逐字节解读（二进制多媒体）。
4) 机械预扫 16 条命中逐条裁决均为良性：CI 工作流两处（DSH-X07/DG-R3-59，.github/workflows/release.yml 与 test.yml）为常规 npm 发布与测试流程；键盘监听两处（DSH-X05/DG-R3-57，client/client.js:234 与 client/mobile/MobileNavOverlay.tsx:99）为 Escape 关闭抽屉的 UI 逻辑；转义文本两处（DSH-X08/DG-R3-60，client/client.js:377 与 test/service.test.js:703）为中文注释/测试数据的 Unicode 转义；进程调用六处（DSH-X03/DG-R3-55，lib/index.js:13、lib/restart.js:14、lib/restart.js:44（字符串字面量而非实际调用）、lib/service.mjs:12、lib/tunnel.mjs:9、LOCAL-DEV.md:48（文档代码块））参数固定或来自宿主自身启动参数；curl 命令四处（DSH-C05/DG-R4-53，LOCAL-DEV.md:58/59/68/105）均为开发文档中本机调试用命令，非实际运行时外发。均未形成发现项。
5) 上版 1.14.5@13e52db3 基线报告为 clean；本版为完整审计（release-full），结论基于当前快照全量核查，与基线结论一致。
limits.en:
